title: Leakage-Resistant Evaluation of AI-Generated Database Specifications in Specification-Driven Migration
abstract: arXiv:2610.12778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a leakage-resistant framework and benchmark (LRFB) for measuring evaluators of AI-generated Oracle PL/SQL specifications. The benchmark contains 494 labelled source-specification pairs across 19 quality metrics grouped into seven dimensions; each metric contains 26 records divided into development and held-out subsets of 13 records each, with three clean and ten defective specifications per subset. Ground truth is mechanically sealed from inference and checked with canary and label-permutation tests. Three LLM judges were evaluated with three runs per record and compared against two trivial baselines. On 247 held-out records, GPT-4o, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 reached balanced accuracies of 0.87, 0.89, and 0.81, respectively, while a specification-length baseline reached 0.88. translated_title: 规范驱动迁移中AI生成数据库规范的抗泄漏评估
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个抗泄漏框架与基准（LRFB），用于测评AI生成的Oracle PL/SQL规范的评估器。该基准包含494对带标签的源代码-规范对，涵盖19个质量指标并归为七个维度；每个指标包含26条记录，划分为开发集与保留集各13条记录，每个子集含三条规范和十条有缺陷的规范。真实标签通过机械化方式与推理隔离，并采用金丝雀测试和标签置换测试进行验证。研究评估了三个LLM评判器，每条记录运行三次，并与两个简单基线进行对比。在247条保留记录上，GPT-4o、DeepSeek V4 Pro和Claude Sonnet 4.5分别达到了0.87、0.89和0.81的平衡准确率，而基于规范长度的基线达到了0.88。精确配对检验无法将任何一个评判器与该基线区分开。然而，评判器仍能提供长度基线所无法获得的信息……
tldr: 本文提出了一个抗泄漏的基准LRFB用于评估AI生成的Oracle PL/SQL规范，发现GPT-4o、DeepSeek V4 Pro和Claude Sonnet 4.5等LLM评判器在平衡准确率上与简单的规范长度基线无显著差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a leakage-resistant benchmark (LRFB) for evaluating AI-generated Oracle PL/SQL specifications, finding that LLM judges such as GPT-4o, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 show no significant advantage over a simple specification-length baseline in balanced accuracy.
